metadata.description: MiniBank v1.4 (P1): log search alerts alr-minibank-failed-value-idr (feature D) and alr-minibank-journey-success-low (feature C). Severity 2, every 5 minutes over 10 minutes, no action group, scope = Application Insights appi-minibank. Queries = monitoring/alerts/*.kql.
Resource ID of Application Insights appi-minibank (APPI_ID).

properties.description: MiniBank failed payment value (HTTP 5xx Transfer + QRIS) >= IDR 100,000,000 in 10 minutes (demo, no notifications)

allOf.query:
requests
| where cloud_RoleName == "minibank-api" and (name endswith "/api/transfer" or name endswith "/api/qris/pay")
| where toint(resultCode) >= 500
| extend FailedValueIdr = todouble(customDimensions["minibank.amountIdr"]) * itemCount
| project timestamp, FailedValueIdr

properties.description: MiniBank customer-journey success rate below 90 percent with at least 2 failed journeys in 10 minutes (demo, no notifications)

allOf.query:
customEvents
| where name == "minibank.journey" and tostring(customDimensions["stage"]) == "end"
| summarize Journeys = sum(itemCount), FailedJourneys = sumif(itemCount, tostring(customDimensions["success"]) != "true")
| where Journeys > 0
| extend SuccessPct = round(100.0 * (Journeys - FailedJourneys) / Journeys, 1)
| where SuccessPct < 90 and FailedJourneys >= 2
